items.title: Billionaire Daniel Loeb Is Betting on These 2 Non-AI Stocks
items.summary: Billionaire Daniel Loeb’s Third Point opened about 16 new positions during the second quarter. Two of the new buys sit well outside the AI trade, and we decided to focus on those for this article.
